name: Freedom Monument
description: A 42-meter monument from 1935, topped by a copper figure of Liberty holding up three stars, and a symbol of Latvian independence.

name: Bastejkalns
description: A small hill park by the city canal, where people were shot during the January 1991 barricades. Memorial stones mark the spots.

name: Dome Square
description: The largest square in the old town, beside Riga Cathedral, the Lutheran cathedral begun in 1211.

name: Mežaparks Great Stage
description: An open-air stage in a pine forest park in northern Riga, built for Latvia’s national song and dance festivals.

name: Latvian National Museum of Art
description: Latvia’s main art museum, in a building opened in 1905, with Latvian painting and sculpture.

name: St. Peter’s Church
description: A Gothic church with a tall spire and a viewing platform, first mentioned in 1209.
